charm.how: Bring every Pokédex entry to research level 10 (Mythicals not needed), then talk to Professor Laventon.

methods.name: Random encounters
methods.plain: Any wild Pokémon starts at 1 in 4,096; research on its Pokédex entry raises that.
methods.detail: 1 try. With the Shiny Charm every entry is already at research level 10, so the charm figure includes that try: 5 in all. Alphas and space-time distortion Pokémon use these odds.
methods.note: RotomLabs; Pokémon GO Hub; alphas and distortions [single]

methods.name: Pokédex research
methods.plain: Research a Pokémon fully: level 10 adds a shiny try, a perfect entry adds two more.
methods.detail: Research level 10: +1 try. Perfect entry: +2 more. The Shiny Charm adds 3.

methods.name: Mass outbreak
methods.plain: Hunt in a mass outbreak: with a perfect Pokédex entry and the Shiny Charm, about 1 in 128 is shiny.
methods.detail: +25 tries in a mass outbreak, on top of research and the Shiny Charm (version 1.1.0 and later).

methods.name: Massive mass outbreak
methods.plain: Massive mass outbreaks (version 1.1.0 and later) help too, a bit less: about 1 in 216 with everything.
methods.detail: +12 tries, on top of research and the Shiny Charm.
